svg.title: Score anonymous answers to a parking-fee problem
svg.desc: Give each helper the same parking rules and visits. Hide its name while you mark the answers. Work out the key. Calculate the fee for each visit from the printed rule. Compare. Give credit for the correct charge and the reasoning the task asks for. Reveal. Look at the tool names only after recording the results.
